_about: Each visit to a course draws a warm dry day and a light, variable canyon breeze from these ranges. The wind is drawn in three stretches of the path (near, middle, far) that differ from one another, each with a gust that changes over time.

low.estimate: a warm day at either range: Santa Clarita's April mean daily high is 74 to 76 F and July's 92 to 100 F (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Santa_Clarita,_California); Fillmore, next to Piru, April 74 F and July 81 F (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fillmore,_California). 72 to 95 F covers a warm spring or summer afternoon at both

low.estimate: no humidity normals were found for either site; a dry inland afternoon in Southern California runs 15 to 40 percent (a single NWS Saugus afternoon reading of 34 percent was found)

low.estimate: Santa Clarita's average hourly wind runs 5.5 to 6.6 mph in summer (https://weatherspark.com/s/1726/1/Average-Summer-Weather-in-Santa-Clarita-California-United-States); a light canyon breeze is drawn between 3 and 10 mph

stretchVariation.estimate: the three stretches of the path differ from the day's wind by up to 35 percent, and the far stretch (up the slope at Piru) is the most different

windFromDegrees.estimate: the wind comes from anywhere but straight down the range: between 20 and 160 degrees (from the right-hand side, clockwise from downrange) or 200 to 340 (from the left), so there is always some crosswind
